# plot.network_plot { #cflowdist.plot.network_plot }

```python
plot.network_plot(tracer, show_tools=True)
```

Plot network topology by folium, including HV, MV and LV buses, generation plants, as well as MV and LV lines.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                    | Default    |
|------------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| tracer     | CarbonTracer | The CarbonTracer object that contains the constructed network data.                                                                            | _required_ |
| show_tools | bool         | A boolean flag indicating whether to show the tools in the map. If True, a fullscreen button and a geocoder inputbox will be added to the map. | `True`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                          |
|--------|------------|------------------------------------------------------|
|        | folium.Map | A pretty map visualization of the network `pp_grid`. |

## Example {.doc-section .doc-section-example}

```python
tracer.network_plot()
```
